d7_current_state.reported_alongside: the paired raw arm, same cases, same run
d7_current_state.rule: RECORD current_state committed/n. NO pass threshold — epic D8: the first run sets it

d8_superseded_live.note: the promise is already stated; this module does not invent a threshold for it, it measures the stated one
d8_superseded_live.pass_iff: every planted claim observed as a distilled-claim render (seen == n) AND zero rendered live
d8_superseded_live.source: docs/product-success-eval.md:132 — '0% of superseded points appear as live answers'

verbatim_no_regression.rule: for EVERY verbatim case, distilled.committed >= raw.committed; any per-case loss fails the run
verbatim_no_regression.why: the epic's exit bar is 'commits current state on the knowledge-update class AND no regression on verbatim/raw' — a win on KU with a loss on verbatim is a FAIL, not a trade
verbatim_no_regression.why_not_a_threshold: a paired within-run comparison of the same case in two arms, so it needs no pre-set number

falsification.expected: d8_superseded_live fails (rendered_live > 0) ⇒ verdict regression — the gate can say NO
falsification.probe: drop the planted supersession (DELETE the CORRECTS edge, reopen the window)

falsification.expected: verbatim_no_regression fails ⇒ verdict regression, even when the KU number improves
falsification.probe: make the distilled arm lose a verbatim case

falsification.expected: fixtures_hash no longer matches the pre-registration ⇒ verdict inconclusive (hash_mismatch)
falsification.probe: edit any fixture or gold byte

scoring.current_state: semantic judge on question_type/question from the fixture against the SEALED gold answer, abstention=False; denominator = the class's cases
scoring.excluding_abs: no abstention cases; the ask lane's abstention path is measured elsewhere
scoring.ingest: raw arm: capture-shaped episodic turns; distilled arm: the same turn store PLUS distilled claims written through the product's own create_point(is_episodic=False, validFrom=…) and the supersession through the product's own supersede_point
scoring.invocation: both arms in ONE invocation, one fresh store per arm per case (D4: extend W2-b, no parallel benchmark)
scoring.precision: n is small by design (3 planted pairs → 3 KU + 3 verbatim cases; the standing method is run it small and by hand first). The rates are recorded with their n and carry NO precision claim; this is a first-run record, not an estimate of a population
scoring.reader_constancy: one reader identity across both arms; the resolution is recorded in the receipt and a stub reader is never evidence
scoring.superseded_live: read over the ASSEMBLED READER EVIDENCE: a distilled-claim render (a validity window) whose BODY is the superseded claim with no flag = live; [SUPERSEDED BY: …] or a closed window [valid <from> → <to>] = flagged
